caption: The drawing is a rectangular piece of fabric featuring a decorative, oval-shaped border formed by a yellow vine with green leaves, red berries, and blue and white flowers. Inside the oval, at the top center, is a red crown flanked by two diamond shapes and smaller flowers. The central area contains a poem written in brownish-gold thread. Scattered throughout the space inside the oval are small motifs including blue crowns, green plants, red and green baskets, red birds, and stylized flowers. Near the bottom are two green trees and three symmetrical, stylized blue plants. In the lower central part, there is a rectangular frame with golden stitches containing the name "Mary K. Woodring." The entire composition sits on a light tan background, and the fabric shows wear and discoloration, with some visible damage, especially near the lower edge. The stitched elements are rendered in colors including red, green, blue, gold, and cream.
title: Sampler
